run_test_options_parse: run TestOptions parse to get CLI arguments for testing hand mocap models
create_test_options_instance: create a TestOptions instance that inherits BaseOptions and adds test-specific CLI arguments
test_dataset_selection: test hand mocap model on a specific dataset like freihand, ho3d, stb, rhd, mtc, wild, or demo
load_checkpoint_for_testing: load a specific checkpoint path and epoch for evaluating hand mocap model performance
visualize_evaluation_results: visualize evaluation results by enabling the visualize_eval flag during test option parsing
